verdict.rationale: Evidence shows GrowthBook ships an official MCP *server* so AI tools like Cursor/Claude can call GrowthBook's API (growthbook-docs-13, growthbook-docs-21, growthbook-probe-3) — this is the reverse relationship (GrowthBook being consumed by agents), not GrowthBook acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence describes GrowthBook connecting to or consuming external MCP servers.
